attributes.title: 50th Annual Family Medicine Update
attributes.cme_provider: North Dakota Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.organizer: North Dakota Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.summary:
Fifty years in, this Monday-to-Thursday meeting mixes morning and afternoon lectures aimed at office-based primary care with time for the slopes. The academy says the program is reshaped each year from attendee comments.

Check the credit before you budget around it: the form lists 17.5 credits, while the conference page says about 17 prescribed hours were submitted and approval is still pending. The $650 rate also covers retired MDs and out-of-state residents. North Dakota residents and medical students attend free but still need to register. Written cancellation at least one month ahead gets a refund minus $50.
